source.selectionMethod: Five repositories selected for recent activity, sustained contribution, implementation depth, delivery evidence, and coverage across the three portfolio domains.
limitations: GitHub activity measures visible project work, not total professional experience or elapsed working hours.
Commit counts vary with repository and merge practices and are not treated as productivity scores.
Preference is inferred from repeated, recent project choices and should be updated when priorities change.
Private repository metadata is included as evidence, but no private source code or secrets are stored here.

kpis.label: Technical Depth
kpis.definition: Complexity demonstrated across architecture, integrations, state, data, infrastructure, and interactions.

kpis.label: Project Breadth
kpis.definition: Range of projects, platforms, technologies, and responsibilities within the domain.

kpis.label: Sustained Work
kpis.definition: Repeated work over time using repository age, recency, and commit history as directional evidence.

kpis.label: Delivery Evidence
kpis.definition: Complete, integrated, tested, published, or deployed outcomes rather than isolated experiments.

kpis.label: Preference Signal
kpis.definition: Repeated emphasis in recent projects; a preference proxy, not a survey response.

domains.label: Full-Stack Engineering
domains.summary: Deepest evidence across application architecture, APIs, state, data, infrastructure, and delivery.

domains.label: Data & Visual Analytics
domains.summary: Evidence spans data modeling, SQL-backed products, operational flows, and custom visualizations.

domains.label: UI/UX & Design Systems
domains.summary: Strong evidence across interaction design, responsive UI, design systems, tokens, themes, and components.

projects.evidence: Production-oriented FastAPI and React application foundation with PostgreSQL, migrations, authentication, infrastructure, configuration, and reusable delivery workflows.
Long-running React, TypeScript, MUI, visualization, responsive design, animation, testing, and GitHub Pages portfolio work.
Manifest V3 React extension with detailed interaction design, state persistence, Firebase authentication and theme sync, responsive panel behavior, and release preparation.
Mobile-first Expo and FastAPI product spanning PostgreSQL modeling, sessions, offline behavior, authentication, infrastructure, state management, and workout-data workflows.
MUI design-system workbench with typed design documents, token editing, theme compilation, component catalogs, Redux state, persistence, and independent appearance controls.
